categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Extends the libbitcoinkernel C API and C++ wrapper with script execution tracing callbacks and hooks across `src/kernel/` and kernel tests.
categories.rationale: Adds build-time script evaluation tracing to the libbitcoinkernel C and C++ APIs, enabling external applications to inspect opcode execution step-by-step for debuggers and analyzers. Multiple reviewers and the author demonstrated working prototypes (such as rust-bitcoinkernel debuggers and visualizers) and highlighted its testing utility, but it is an auxiliary diagnostic feature rather than core kernel decoupling or validation API completeness.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Excluded by category definition: its primary subject is the kernel library API, and the macro hooks in `src/script/interpreter.cpp` do not alter consensus logic or validation behavior.
categories.rationale: The PR is not a member of validation because its primary subject is the kernel library API and it introduces build-time instrumentation without substantively altering consensus rules or runtime validation invariants. The validation category explicitly excludes kernel API changes that do not alter what the node accepts, chainstate maintenance, or validation performance.
